bio.text: Vic Mellor, a Warwick businessman, won the Republican primary for Rhode Island's 2nd Congressional District on September 9, 2026, defeating Dr. Stephen Skoly, and faces Democratic U.S. Rep. Seth Magaziner in the November 3 general election.
Rhode Island Current describes the 56-year-old as an entrepreneur and former Marine who moved back to Rhode Island in 2025 after several decades in Florida.

sources.title: Vic Mellor wins Republican CD2 primary
